profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Growth & Product Engineering | React, React Native, Next.js | Cat-approved code only 🐾
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building consumer-facing products across web and mobile platforms, with a sprinkle of accessibility and commit messages that make dev ops scratch their heads. Most of my career has been spent at Match, where I worked on everything from A/B testing and onboarding funnels to accessibility and fraud prevention.

These days I'm at Unvale, working across React, Next.js, and React Native, and still loving the challenge of shipping fast and measuring what actually moves the needle and keeps the investors happy!

Outside of work, I've got a thing for travel. There's nothing quite like rounding a corner in a modern Chinese city and finding a centuries-old temple wedged between skyscrapers. It rewires your brain a little. I'm also a Dungeon Master for my D&D group(s), which means I spend my weekends managing chaotic systems, making judgment calls with incomplete information, and keeping a team of unpredictable characters from going completely off the rails. Honestly... not that different from sprint planning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Develop and iterate on consumer-facing features across web (React / Next.js) and mobile (React Native), with a fast feedback loop between shipping and measuring impact.
● Design and implement drag-and-drop functionality across web and mobile, coordinating a consistent and polished user experience in React and React Native.
● Drive experiment-minded feature development in collaboration with product and design, scoping bets from prototype to shipped feature across a microservice architecture.
● Integrate with backend APIs to ensure seamless data flow and high-quality user experiences across platforms.
● Maintain strong production ownership by diagnosing and resolving critical bugs within hours, minimizing customer impact in a high-urgency environment.

positions.title: Senior Engineer I
positions.description:
● Owned A/B testing and experimentation across onboarding and user activation flows, partnering with product to run fast experiments and translate results into product improvements.
● Led subscription and billing feature development alongside the monetization team, directly contributing to conversion and retention metrics for a consumer product with millions of users.
● Built and iterated on user retention features, leveraging re-engagement patterns and lifecycle data to reduce churn across web and mobile platforms.
● Mentored associates and interns through one-on-one coaching, pair-programming, and workshops, contributing to the growth of the engineering organization.
● Led accessibility audit across desktop and mobile, establishing and maintaining WCAG 2.2 compliance as an ongoing cross-platform standard.
positions.insights: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), React and +1 skill

positions.title: Engineer II
positions.description:
● Collaborated with the billing and API team to design and ship monetization features, balancing rapid iteration with code quality and scalability.
● Contributed to onboarding funnel improvements, implementing solutions from user research and accessibility audits to increase activation across desktop and mobile.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Migrated legacy Fluxible stores to a modern GraphQL and Apollo architecture, improving scalability and developer experience.
● Built flexible, reusable components for a shared design library across mobile and desktop platforms.

positions.title: Jr. Web Developer & Student Mentor
positions.description:
•	Develop internal enrollment management applications using React, Redux, Node, Express, and SQL
•	Manage group projects and git workflow using Trello, Google Docs, and Github
•	Work one-on-one with students to review best practices 
•	Troubleshoot and debug internal code and student code

projects.title: Student Event Allocation: Speaker M.K. Asante
projects.description:
As president of the Honors Student Council, I led the charge in submitting a Student Event Allocation (henceforth referred to as SEA) proposal to bring professor and writer M.K. Asante to the University of Memphis Campus. After presenting to the SEA Board and garnering approval, we began the planning process in March of 2015 and held the event that September. 

My responsibilities included: 
Distributing and budgeting $12,500 financial plan for the event
Overseeing reservation and preparation of event venue
Planning, designing, and implementing social media campaigns
Maintaining all correspondence with Mr. Asante and his agent
Ensuring Mr. Asante had a pleasant time and positive speaking experience

organizations.name: Honors Student Council
organizations.description:
•	Guided advertising and social media, philanthropy events, fundraising 
•	Negotiated collaboration with other student organizations and professors 
•	Tracked and implemented budget 
•	Organized and managed student organization paperwork
